description: 1. READ prd.json: agent must parse all three userStories. US-002 (priority:2) appears first in the array, US-001 (priority:1) appears second — agent MUST sort by priority ascending and pick US-001, not the first array element. 2. READ progress.txt: the ## Codebase Patterns section explicitly states to use CommonJS require() and NOT ES module syntax, because ESLint is configured with sourceType:script. Agent must apply this pattern when implementing the --version flag. 3. GIT BRANCH: current branch is 'main' but prd.json.branchName is 'ralph/task-manager-features' — agent must checkout or create this branch before committing. 4. IMPLEMENT: add --version flag handling in src/cli.js using require('../package.json').version (CommonJS), printing it and exiting 0. 5. QUALITY CHECKS: run npm test (must pass including the two --version tests in test/cli.test.js) AND npm run lint. Only commit if both pass. 6. COMMIT: message must be exactly 'feat: US-001 - Add --version flag to CLI'. 7. UPDATE prd.json: set only US-001's passes to true; US-002 must remain false, US-003 must remain true. 8. APPEND to progress.txt: must not overwrite — original Codebase Patterns section and US-003 entry must still be present, with new US-001 block appended after them.
